end.summary:
- Discussed how earthworm tunnels let air and water into soil.
- Discussed how soil animals turn dead leaves into rich soil.
- Pihu repeated the belief that earthworms spoil soil and should be removed.
- Teach-back was not passed; the misconception was not corrected by the end.
end.parentNote: Asha practised how earthworm tunnels let air and water into soil and how soil animals help turn dead leaves into rich soil. Pihu asked questions and revisited the field-and-pot example, but continued to say that earthworms spoil soil; this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, look at a simple earthworm diagram together and ask Pihu to say one way tunnels help soil.
